### What Does it Mean to Offer God a "Sacrifice of Praise"?
Author: Debbie McDaniel
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/what-does-it-mean-to-offer-god-a-sacrifice-of-praise-bible-study-minute-november-26-2018.html
Passage: Hebrews 13:15
Points:
- Honoring God through worship releases spiritual power, but daily demands often crowd it out.
- Worship risks becoming an empty routine if believers merely attend church without engaged hearts.
- Giving praise becomes a true sacrifice when carried out amid exhaustion, grief, or personal trials.
- Intentionally fixing one's eyes on God loosens the grip that anxiety and hardships have over life.

### The Power of Sharing
Author: Amy Carroll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-apr-3-2007-11536205.html
Passage: Hebrews 13:16
Points:
- While adults readily share time or material items, they often hesitate to share their authentic selves and past struggles.
- Fear of vulnerability, shame, and competition frequently hinder deeper fellowship and mutual support.
- Christian growth is profoundly shaped when believers generously pour their gifts, wisdom, and love into others.
- Jesus demonstrated sacrificial sharing by laying down His life, providing a model for pleasing God through generosity.
